description: The optional metadata section — free-form author-facing facts (title, description, authors, tags, a custom bag). Nothing here is read by the engine; see WorldMetadataSection.

title.description: The world's author-facing display name, distinct from its filename.

items.description: One credited author on a WorldMetadataSection.

oid.description: The author's Entra object id, when the author chooses to attach one — see WorldEntraObjectId. Authored, not authenticated: nothing here proves the name behind the id.

tags.description: Free author vocabulary (genre, theme, whatever an author wants) — no built-in enum, the same posture Names already carries for a property name.

custom.description: A free-form author bag — see the type remarks for its two compose-time carve-outs.
